<Project>

  <PropertyGroup>
    <TargetFramework>net10.0</TargetFramework>
    <LangVersion>latest</LangVersion>
    <Nullable>enable</Nullable>
    <ImplicitUsings>enable</ImplicitUsings>
    <InvariantGlobalization>true</InvariantGlobalization>
    <IsPackable>false</IsPackable>
    <EnforceCodeStyleInBuild>true</EnforceCodeStyleInBuild>
    <TreatWarningsAsErrors>true</TreatWarningsAsErrors>
    <NoWarn>$(NoWarn);1591</NoWarn>
    <CopyDebugSymbolFilesFromPackages>true</CopyDebugSymbolFilesFromPackages>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <!-- Identify CI build -->
  <PropertyGroup Condition="'$(TF_BUILD)' == 'true'">
    <ContinuousIntegrationBuild>true</ContinuousIntegrationBuild>
  </PropertyGroup>
  <PropertyGroup Condition="'$(GITHUB_ACTIONS)' == 'true'">
    <ContinuousIntegrationBuild>true</ContinuousIntegrationBuild>
  </PropertyGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="FluentResults" />
  </ItemGroup>

  <ItemGroup>
    <Using Include="FluentResults" />
    <Using Include="Microsoft.Extensions.Logging" />
    <Using Include="System.Collections.Immutable" />
  </ItemGroup>

</Project>

<Project>
  <PropertyGroup>
    <!-- Enable Ccentral package management -->
    <ManagePackageVersionsCentrally>true</ManagePackageVersionsCentrally>
    <CentralPackageTransitivePinningEnabled>true</CentralPackageTransitivePinningEnabled>
    <!-- Enable package auditing -->
    <NuGetAudit>true</NuGetAudit>
    <NuGetAuditLevel>high</NuGetAuditLevel>
    <NuGetAuditMode>all</NuGetAuditMode>
    <!-- Generate the lock file -->
    <RestorePackagesWithLockFile>true</RestorePackagesWithLockFile>
    <!-- Restore the exact packages as listed in the lock file -->
    <RestoreLockedMode Condition="'$(ContinuousIntegrationBuild)' == 'true'">true</RestoreLockedMode>
  </PropertyGroup>
  <ItemGroup>

    <PackageVersion Include="Asp.Versioning.Http" Version="10.0.0" />

  <packageSources>
    <clear />

  </packageSources>
  <packageSourceCredentials>
    <github>
      <add key="Username" value="github" />
      <add key="ClearTextPassword" value="%GITHUB_TOKEN%" />
    </github>
  </packageSourceCredentials>
  <!-- Define mappings by adding package patterns beneath the target source. -->
  <!-- Volvo Cars packages will be restored from github, everything else from nuget.org. -->
  <packageSourceMapping>
    <!-- key value for <packageSource> should match key values from <packageSources> element -->
    <packageSource key="nuget.org">
      <package pattern="*" />
    </packageSource>
    <packageSource key="github">
      <package pattern="VolvoCars.*" />
      <package pattern="Volvocars.*" />
    </packageSource>
  </packageSourceMapping>
</configuration>
